What does the system need to handle there?"},{"id":"M1:T5","text":"So the ETCS trainborne equipment has to be able to supervise a whole set of operational states, and those are"},{"id":"M1:T6","text":"Okay, go on."},{"id":"M1:T7","text":"Full Supervision, Partial Supervision, Staff Responsible, On Sight, Unfitted Line, Train Trip, Post Trip, National operation, that's STM, then Tandem, Multiple, Shunting, Stand By and Reversing operation."},{"id":"M1:T8","text":"And any transition that happens while the train is moving should, in principle, happen automatically."},{"id":"M1:T9","text":"Got it."},{"id":"M1:T10","text":"Yes, that makes sense."},{"id":"M1:T11","text":"Then, maybe, and I'm not sure it's strictly needed, but in case the transition has to be acknowledged"},{"id":"M1:T12","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M1:T13","text":"and the driver doesn't acknowledge it the way they're supposed to"},{"id":"M1:T14","text":"Right."},{"id":"M1:T15","text":"Would that apply to—"},{"id":"M1:T16","text":"Sorry, let me finish."},{"id":"M1:T17","text":"then the ETCS should trigger a brake application."},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"Quick thing, someone's audio is echoing a bit, could you mute if you're not talking?"},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"Okay, thanks."},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"And the driver should see the, no, sorry, the current operational status should be shown to the driver on the DMI."}]}
